title: Trust Fund Baby
tagline: On-chain trust fund for your grandkids. Stake ETH and let compounding does it magic.
description:
Trust funds for the weak hands. Manage inheritance and wealth for your love ones in one place with smart contract wallet.

✨ Features ✨

✦ Customized conditions for fund release (beneficiary address, maturity date, ETH target price). And funds converted into stETH for additional yield, optimizing capital efficiency.

✦ Early principal withdrawals with sales tax to discourage frequent or unnecessary withdrawals.

⚙️ Here's how it works ⚙️

1. Wallet Setup: Alice creates a smart contract wallet on Scroll/Arbitrum.

2. Conditions Set: Alice defines specific conditions for fund disbursement, signing a transaction to set them.

3. Attestation Schema: Register onchain attestation schema on Ethereum Attestation Service (EAS) using the signed transaction.

4. Claim Process: Beneficiaries use EAS-generated UID to inquire about attestation status. Upon meeting conditions, beneficiaries claim funds directly from the smart contract.
how_its_made:
Smart Contracts: We've built the smart contract wallet. Users could use any address for example 0x123 to call wallet factory, this wallet factory will create an independent smart contract wallet (owner 0x123). 

Ethereum Attestation Service -  We leverage EAS's EIP-1271 to enable efficient and secure signature authentication to register onchain attestation schema. 

L2s: We deploy on both Arbitrum & Scroll. 

Foundry: For testing and deploying
